_comment: Candidate-only native control policy for the Template implementation worker, applied through bin/gct-claude-template-candidate-worker.
The wrapper removes the generated shared settings and loads no ambient setting sources, so this file is the whole user/project/local permission set (host managed-policy settings still apply).

The native file tools are bound to the dedicated Template candidate worktree root. The worktree .git link, publication commands, network tools, classified vault, shared settings, and credential stores are denied.
Project shell work stays in the fail-closed sandbox; only the five native control commands leave it. Reviewed native hooks are the Core policy hooks byte-for-byte.

hooks.command: export GC_HOME="$HOME/gascity/home"; export PATH="$HOME/gascity/bin:$PATH"; "$HOME/gascity/bin/gc" --city "$HOME/gascity/city" handoff --auto "context cycle"

export GC_HOME="$HOME/gascity/home"; export PATH="$HOME/gascity/bin:$PATH"; GC_MANAGED_SESSION_HOOK=1 GC_HOOK_EVENT_NAME=SessionStart "$HOME/gascity/bin/gc" --city "$HOME/gascity/city" prime --hook --hook-format codex
export GC_HOME="$HOME/gascity/home"; export PATH="$HOME/gascity/bin:$PATH"; "$HOME/gascity/bin/gc" --city "$HOME/gascity/city" hook run --timeout 15s --timeout-exit-code 0 -- nudge drain --inject
export GC_HOME="$HOME/gascity/home"; export PATH="$HOME/gascity/bin:$PATH"; "$HOME/gascity/bin/gc" --city "$HOME/gascity/city" hook run --timeout 15s --timeout-exit-code 0 -- mail check --inject
